# WooCommerce Theme Development Project

A clean, simple, and lean WooCommerce template for WordPress.

## Project Files Created

- **style.css** - Main stylesheet with responsive design, header, teaser section, product grid, and footer styles
- **index.php** - Main template file
- **functions.php** - Theme setup, enqueue scripts/styles, widget registration, custom header and footer functions
- **woocommerce.php** - WooCommerce integration template
- **js/navigation.js** - Burger menu functionality
- **README.md** - Installation and usage documentation

## Features Implemented

✅ Header with logo space, main navigation menu, and responsive burger menu
✅ Teaser section with large headline and CTA button
✅ Product samples grid layout (auto-responsive)
✅ Footer with widget area and site info
✅ Mobile-first responsive design
✅ SEO-friendly structure
✅ WooCommerce support and integration
✅ Clean, semantic HTML5
✅ ES6+ JavaScript for navigation
